name: google-ads-audit
description: Full Google Ads account audit driven by the Google Ads MCP (GAQL). Scores live data against a comprehensive 9-step audit framework plus modern Google checks (PMax, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions, Demand Gen) and emits a 3-format deliverable bundle from one findings JSON: an interactive, self-contained, white-label HTML report (the primary deliverable, with a live Health-Score gauge and ICE re-ranking), an Obsidian-ready markdown record, and a formula-driven multi-tab xlsx backup. HTML + markdown are standard-library only; the xlsx backup needs openpyxl.

interface.shortDescription: Audit Google Ads accounts and build client-ready reports.
interface.longDescription: Analyze live GAQL data against a nine-step audit framework, score account health, and generate synchronized HTML, Markdown, and XLSX deliverables with prioritized findings.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Google Ads account and prioritize the findings.
Build the HTML, Markdown, and XLSX audit bundle.
Review this Google Ads export for wasted spend.
